{{samename|series of the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]|Appendix:Glossary (TCG)#Series|Appendix:Glossary (TCG) → Series}} [[File:Pokémon the Series logo.png|thumb|300px|''Pokémon the Series'']] A '''series''' (Japanese: '''シリーズ''' ''series'') of the [[Pokémon animated series]] is a collection of [[List of animated series episodes|episodes]] that corresponds roughly to a specific [[generation]] of {{pkmn|games}}. In Asia (including Japan), there are currently eight series.[https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1905213208388137026 アニメ「ポケットモンスター」公式 on X (Twitter)][https://sg.portal-pokemon.com/anime/ TV Anime Series | The official Pokémon Website in Singapore] These generally match the title used for those episodes of the TV series in broadcast and home video releases, although there are cases where they have gone under a different title (such as ''Pocket Monsters Episode: Orange Islands'', ''Pocket Monsters [[Best Wishes! Season 2]]'', and ''Pocket Monsters XY&Z''). In the West, there are currently nine series, the first eight of which are part of {{aniseries|PtS}}.[https://www.pokemon.com/us/animation/where-to-watch-pokemon-episodes-movies Where to Watch Pokémon Episodes & Movies | Pokemon.com] This distinction was not properly made until ''[[S17|Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', which introduced a name for the series, being followed by some older series retroactively receiving similar names in {{cat|Animation home video|home video box sets}} and [[List of digital home video releases of Pokémon animation|video-on-demand releases]]. Unlike in Japan, the TV series is more often divided into [[season]]s, which are the primary titles used by episodes of the TV series in broadcast and home video releases. Since [[4Kids Entertainment]] stopped dubbing the animated series, seasons have never contained episodes from more than one series, being cut off at series divisions.
